phrases.text_l1: عييت من الصبر ربي قلبي عمر
phrases.text_l2: I'm tired of patience, Lord, my heart is worn
This life is too hard on me

phrases.text_l1: عييت من قاسي عييت من جري
phrases.text_l2: I'm tired of hardship, tired of running
Oh Lord, look at my state

phrases.text_l1: ليك يا العالي أنا نعود ونبكي
phrases.text_l2: To You, Oh High One, I return and weep

phrases.text_l1: وانت نعم على اللي في قلبي
phrases.text_l2: And You know best what lies in my heart
And those who parted ways with me
You hold judgment over them, Oh High One
I ask and seek among the people, oh me
Oh me, they asked me where she is
I ask and seek for the light of my eyes
Oh me, they asked me what ails her
Say they left me, betrayed me for Your sake

phrases.text_l1: قولي فارقوني عندك في أحكام يا العالي
phrases.text_l2: Say they left me, You hold judgment, Oh High One
Night and day, I walk sleepless
And your separation reached me, far away

phrases.text_l1: غادي في السمر غادي في البحر
phrases.text_l2: Walking in the night, walking in the sea
I ask and seek night and day
For my soul, and my eyes are lost
The one who left and vanished from me
And to a stranger, alone, I became
What can I do, Oh Lord?
I ask and seek among the people, oh me
Oh me, they asked me where she is
I ask and seek for the light of my eyes
Oh me, they asked me what ails her
Say they left me, betrayed me for Your sake

phrases.text_l2: Say they left me, You hold judgment, Oh High One

Oh me, they asked me what ails her
Say they left me, betrayed me for Your sake
